theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Match Your Goals With Investment Timelines
body: Different life goals need different time horizons. Align your investment approach based on when you need the funds.
caption: Whether saving for education, a home, retirement, or a wedding, matching your investment timeline to your goal's timeframe matters. Starting early gives compounding more time to work. #GoalBasedInvesting #InvestmentTimeline #WealthBuilding #SmartMoney #FutureReady
